documents.t: Worked examples — executed notebooks rendered as pages (refreshed weekly against the live APIs): Quickstart
Hand-written wrappers, loaders, and helpers in sportsdataverse.basketball.ibba that are not generated API-endpoint wrappers (those have their own reference pages).

ibba_segev_game_crosswalk(df: 'pl.DataFrame', *, return_as_pandas: 'bool' = False) -> 'Any' IBBA game_id <-> Segev game_id from ibba_games (the segev_game_id column). Parameters Returns polars.DataFrame | pandas.DataFrame: game_id (IBBA) and segev_game_id (the game_id every ibba_segev_* wrapper takes), both Int64. Raises Example from sportsdataverse.basketball.basketball_crosswalk import ibba_segev_game_crosswalk from sportsdataverse.basketball.ibba import ibba_games xw = ibba_segev_game_crosswalk(ibba_games(season=2026))

sportsdataverse.basketball.ibba — 16 endpoints. Note: Access (sdv-internal-refs/ibba/README.md): unofficial and reverse-engineered, keyless, for internal use. The wrappers read basket.co.il's ASP.NET web service (the ops its own site calls) and space requests at least one second apart; keep crawls slow and incremental. Payloads are not redistributed as release assets. Contact details (e-mail, phone, fax) and coaches' dates of birth are dropped by the parsers. Note: Season and ids. season is the END year and the host's own cYear (2026 = 2025-26): no mapping. team_id and player_id are per-SEASON registrations (Maccabi Tel Aviv = team 1109 in 2025-26, 2111 in 2026-27; the ASMX host has no cross-season person id: the stable key is the Segev player id in ibba_segev_*). team_uid is the stable club id (Maccabi = 10). ibba_games.segev_game_id joins ibba_segev_* game_id from 2025-26. Note: Coverage: league box scores from 2004-05 (season=2005); external_id / segev_game_id only from 2025-26; the women's league and Liga Leumit are NOT on this host (they are on Genius Sports org IBBA and in Segev). Every ASMX value is a string and Hebrew text is HTML-entity encoded; the parsers cast ids, counts and dates and unescape text. An unknown id answers an empty body (NoDataError); box scores of unfinished games are refused.

sportsdataverse.basketball.ibba — 6 endpoints. Note: Access (sdv-internal-refs/ibba/README.md): Segev Stats is the live-stats vendor behind basket.co.il's game pages; its JSON-RPC API is keyless, unofficial and not documented for outside use. The wrappers space requests at least one second apart and read only finished games; payloads are not redistributed as release assets. The host serves JSON as text/html. Note: Games and ids. game_id is one flat Segev id space across seasons AND competitions: men's Winner League, Winner Cup, women's, Leumit, youth, school and pre-season games share it, so read competition from ibba_segev_game_info (team names do not separate men from women reliably). There is no game list: league game ids come from ibba_games.segev_game_id (2025-26 on), the women's league and Leumit from a scan or Genius Sports org IBBA. Segev team and player ids are stable across seasons (Jaylen Hoard = player 1000 in games 50 and 419), unlike the IBBA season registrations, and are not IBBA ids. Note: Play-by-play: actions name the player by Segev id and by JERSEY number, score reads away-home, and shot x / y are one half-court frame (x 0-1470 across, basket near 735; y out from the baseline, rim near 112-140); which sideline is x = 0 and the metric scale are unverified. Segev renamed its team game stats between 2025-26 and 2026-27; the parsers unify them. Unfinished games and ids of another game are refused.
